essays.title: Our school library
essays.prompt: Write about a place in your school that matters to you.
essays.text: My school have a big library on the first floor. Every day my friend go there after lunch and read comics. The librarian discuss about new books with us on morning. In order to borrow a book, a student need a library card. I think reading is important because it help us learn new words. However, some students depend of the internet for everything. Our library should open on Sunday so that everyone can come and read.

essays.title: Weekends at home
essays.prompt: Describe how your family spends weekends.
essays.text: On weekends my brother play cricket with his friends in the park near our house. I usually stay at home and read a novel or help my mother in the kitchen. Last week we all went to the park together and had a picnic under a big tree. It was a lovely day and nobody wanted to go home.
